name: After Dark
source:
How do you cope with your trauma? Do you run from it or face it head on?

You are playing the role of the protagonist who hasn’t been able to sleep for over 10 years, haunted by the shadows of an event he can’t remember. Feeling disconnected from the world and struggling to forge meaningful connections, his life takes a sudden turn at the start of his final year of school. A chance encounter with a mysterious, mystical figure reveals that his destiny is far greater than he ever imagined.
